text: EL is down 17% with revenue declining 8.2% and sitting 34% off its high — trim this position to limit further damage while the turnaround story remains unproven.
ONDS is down 14.8% and 35% off its high with a tiny market cap and no profitability — reduce your exposure because explosive revenue from a small base doesn't offset the cash burn risk.
META offers a rare combination of a low 16.9x PE, 22% revenue growth, strong free cash flow, and consistent earnings — this pullback is a quality-at-a-discount opportunity to add shares.
MSFT is down 13.4% but revenue is growing 15% with strong cash flow and reliable earnings — this is one of the best businesses in the world on sale, worth adding to.
VTR scores a perfect 5.0 as a breakout candidate with confirmed accumulation in healthcare real estate — a new small position here benefits from the easing rate environment which helps REITs.
